title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-08-01 06:02:41 最新章节：第227章权限22
slug: 我的民俗游戏机第227章权限
content_zh:
一罐气泡水下肚，许峰发出满意的龙吟。
“爽！”
从侧房退出来，上锁，防止山上的野猴子不请自取后，许峰看了一眼手表，知道时间差不多。
该去打卡了。
山里的夜黑的很快，此刻还有天光，可是片刻之后，这里就会被黑暗一口吞噬，整个护林小院就落入文明之外。
所以他提前打开了灯泡，有条不紊地开始工作。
这里是苏云省的云架山自然保护区。
他的这护林员小院，属于“孤军深入”，狠狠地插入了整个保护区的心脏。
周围无人，和自然为伍。
极其孤独。
但许峰就喜欢这样。
他上辈子因为太卷猝死，穿越过来之后，他就喜欢躺平！
这个工作是铁饭碗，还不用和人交流，许峰十分喜欢。
就是偶尔会无聊。
六点半，许峰打卡！
对他而言，这个工作，什么都好，但是有一件不妙之事，就是考核严厉！
每年三百六十五天，除了回家轮换，其余每一天，都要打卡。
并且整个打卡设计，相当缜密，没有什么明显漏洞可钻。
首先是巡逻前打卡。
其次是巡逻中打卡。

至于最后，就是傍晚六点三十分的准时打卡了。
吃了晚饭，许峰按时来到打卡室，无视了旁边的红色有线电话。按手印，睁大眼睛将脸靠近了打卡机，听到了里面发出了“嘀”的一声后。
打卡完成。
打卡机传出死板的机械声音。
“员工许峰，验证通过”。
许峰满意地点了点头，转头锁门，出去了。
而在机器另外一边，一行行文字快速地出现，映入了一个人的眼睛里面。
【云架山地区看守人打卡完成】
【虹膜验证通过】
【生物验证通过】
【排除死亡可能】
【不排除感染可能】
【转人工】
许峰以为打卡完毕，实则打卡机上面的微型摄像头，调出了许峰离开的背影。
确定无误之后。
机器旁边之人按下了一个按钮。
【安全上报成功】
【云架山附近，暂时安全】
【压物暂无破封风险】
……
content_en:
After drinking a can of sparkling water, Xu Feng let out a roar of satisfaction.
"It's cool!"
After exiting the side room and locking it to prevent wild monkeys from taking it uninvited, Xu Feng glanced at his watch and knew it was almost time.
It's time to check in.
The night in the mountains gets dark very quickly. There is still daylight at the moment, but in a moment, the place will be swallowed up by darkness, and the entire forest ranger's courtyard will fall outside of civilization.
So he turned on the light bulb in advance and started working methodically.
This is the Yunjia Mountain Nature Reserve in Soyun Province.
His small ranger courtyard is a "solitary force going deep" and has penetrated deeply into the heart of the entire protected area.
There is no one around, and you are in harmony with nature.
Extremely lonely.
But Xu Feng likes this.
He died suddenly due to Taijuan in his previous life. After time traveling, he liked to lie down!
This job is an iron rice bowl, and you don't have to interact with others. Xu Feng likes it very much.
It just gets boring sometimes.
At half past six, Xu Feng clocked in!
For him, everything about this job is good, but there is one bad thing: the assessment is strict!
There are three hundred and sixty-five days a year. Except for the rotation at home, every other day has to be clocked in.
And the entire check-in design is quite meticulous, with no obvious loopholes to exploit.
The first is to clock in before patrolling.
The second is to clock in during patrol.
As for the last thing, I clocked in on time at 6:30 in the evening.
After dinner, Xu Feng came to the check-in room on time and ignored the red wired phone next to him. After pressing your fingerprints, you opened your eyes wide and put your face close to the punch card machine, and heard a "beep" sound coming from it.
Check in and complete.
The punch card machine made a dull mechanical sound.
"Employee Xu Feng, verification passed."
Xu Feng nodded with satisfaction, turned around, locked the door, and went out.
On the other side of the machine, lines of text appeared quickly, reflecting into a person's eyes.
[Yunjiashan Area Warden Check-in Completed]
[Iris verification passed]
[Biological verification passed]
[Exclude the possibility of death]
[The possibility of infection cannot be ruled out]
【Transfer to manual】
Xu Feng thought he had finished punching in, but in fact, the miniature camera on the clocking machine showed Xu Feng's leaving figure.
After confirming it is correct.
The person next to the machine pressed a button.
[Safety report successful]
[Near Yunjia Mountain, temporarily safe]
[There is no risk of the pressure being broken]
…
